Partner Welcome Pack

Edition 5 · August 2026 · Examplecare Integration Exchange

Welcome

Welcome to the Examplecare Integration Exchange. This pack takes a new partner team from credential issue to the first settled transaction, explains the sandbox environment, and lists who to contact when something is unclear.

Onboarding checklist

  • Return the signed scope agreement.
  • Nominate a technical contact and an operations contact.
  • Complete the sandbox connectivity test.
  • Pass the rate-limit conformance check.
  • Schedule the go-live review.

Contacts

Integration questions go to integrations@examplecare.example. Operational incidents are raised through the partner portal and are acknowledged within four business hours.
